sa.active = true ) SELECT tp.id, u.name, tp.business_name, u.phone, (SELECT count(*) FROM technician_assignment load_assignment WHERE load_assignment.technician_id = tp.id AND load_assignment.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'ON_THE_WAY', 'WORK_STARTED')) AS active_count FROM reservation r JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN address_region target ON target.reservation_id = r.id JOIN technician_profile tp ON tp.active = true AND tp.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND tp.license_info IS NOT NULL AND trim(tp.license_info) <> '' JOIN app_user u ON u.id = tp.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN user_role role ON role.user_id = u.id AND role.role_code = 'TECHNICIAN' WHERE r.id = #{reservationId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM technician_region region WHERE region.technician_id = tp.id AND region.province = target.origin_province AND (region.district IS NULL OR region.district = target.origin_district)) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM technician_region region WHERE region.technician_id = tp.id AND region.province = target.destination_province AND (region.district IS NULL OR region.district = target.destination_district)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM move_item required_item WHERE required_item.move_request_id = mr.id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM technician_capability capability WHERE availability.technician_id = tp.id AND availability.active = true AND availability.day_of_week = extract(isodow FROM r.scheduled_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::smallint AND availability.start_time <= (r.scheduled_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::time AND availability.end_time >= (r.scheduled_end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::time AND (r.scheduled_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (r.scheduled_end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM technician_assignment prior_assignment WHERE prior_assignment.technician_id = tp.id AND prior_assignment.reservation_id = r.id AND prior_assignment.status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM technician_assignment existing JOIN reservation occupied ON occupied.id = existing.reservation_id WHERE existing.technician_id = tp.id AND existing.reservation_id <> r.id AND existing.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'ON_THE_WAY', 'WORK_STARTED') AND occupied.scheduled_start_at < r.scheduled_end_at AND occupied.scheduled_end_at > r.scheduled_start_at) ORDER BY active_count, tp.created_at, tp.id LIMIT 100

SELECT r.id FROM reservation r WHERE r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (#{afterId,jdbcType=OTHER}::uuid IS NULL OR r.id > #{afterId,jdbcType=OTHER}::uuid) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM technician_assignment ta WHERE ta.reservation_id = r.id AND ta.status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.select: SELECT ta.id, r.move_request_id, ta.status, r.reservation_no, r.scheduled_start_at, r.scheduled_end_at, customer.name AS customer_name, customer.phone AS customer_phone, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, string_agg(DISTINCT appliance_type.name, ', ' ORDER BY appliance_type.name) AS appliance_types, mr.customer_memo, quote.quote_no, quote.total_amount FROM technician_assignment ta JOIN reservation r ON r.id = ta.reservation_id JOIN quote ON quote.id = r.quote_id JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id JOIN move_item mi ON mi.move_request_id = mr.id JOIN appliance_type ON appliance_type.id = mi.appliance_type_id WHERE ta.id = #{assignmentId} GROUP BY ta.id, r.move_request_id, ta.status, r.reservation_no, r.scheduled_start_at, r.scheduled_end_at, customer.name, customer.phone, mr.origin_address, mr.destination_address, mr.customer_memo, quote.quote_no, quote.total_amount

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, tp.approval_status, tp.active, tp.business_name, tp.license_info, (SELECT string_agg(area.region_code, ', ' ORDER BY area.region_code) FROM technician_service_area area WHERE area.technician_id = tp.id AND area.active = true) AS service_areas, (SELECT string_agg(appliance_type.code, ', ' ORDER BY appliance_type.code) FROM technician_capability capability JOIN appliance_type ON appliance_type.id = capability.appliance_type_id WHERE capability.technician_id = tp.id AND capability.active = true) AS appliance_codes, (SELECT string_agg( availability.day_of_week || ':' || to_char(availability.start_time, 'HH24:MI') || '-' || to_char(availability.end_time, 'HH24:MI'), ', ' ORDER BY availability.day_of_week, availability.start_time) FROM technician_availability availability WHERE availability.technician_id = tp.id AND availability.active = true) AS availability FROM technician_profile tp JOIN app_user u ON u.id = tp.user_id WHERE (#{approvalStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::varchar IS NULL OR tp.approval_status = #{approvalStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY tp.created_at DESC, tp.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
